milestones.title: Wave 00 — Foundation and reviewed scientific programs
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Clean pinned Lean/Mathlib/physics build; declaration audit; 40 reviewed valid targets and 20 negative cases with reference outcomes and family holdouts. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 01 — Independent proof acceptance
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Real isolated Linux construction, Comparator and kernel runs; complete dependency/axiom checks; seeded attacks rejected or held for semantic review. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 02 — Single-agent research loop
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Live accepted proof and subsequent accepted-lemma reuse in both quantum and classical programs. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 03 — Durable managed execution
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Managed deployment and fault injection: VM/controller loss, duplicates, cancellation and pause/resume preserve canonical records and resource accounting. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 04 — Heterogeneous collaboration and memory
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Mixed-runtime team completes reusable work, survives parent loss and repeated compaction with unchanged assumptions and proof status. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 05 — Knowledge and autoformalization
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Held-out applicable premise retrieval and source correspondence produce a reviewed formal target accepted by independent verification. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 06 — Test-time scaling and portfolios
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Matched-cost and matched-time comparisons measure solver outcomes, uncertainty and coordination costs before policy promotion. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 07 — Computation-assisted discovery
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Both programs demonstrate computation-assisted checked claims; unsupported numerical evidence retains its non-proof status. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 08 — Production qualification at 128 workers
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Full operational acceptance criteria and 72-hour mixed workload at 128 active worker slots with injected failures. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 09 — Thousand-worker and self-hosted execution
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Managed and self-hosted provider qualification; 1,000 active workers doing useful work with measured overhead and recovery. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 10 — Learning from verified experience
milestones.description: Qualification gate: A learned component shows reproducible held-out benefit under the same acceptance policy with rollback; retain/report a non-learning baseline if none qualifies. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

milestones.title: Wave 11 — Sustained open-problem campaigns
milestones.description: Qualification gate: Nontrivial new results with expert-confirmed meaning and novelty, independent proofs and reproducible sustained campaigns toward difficult root targets. No fixed due date. Full scope: docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.
